description: Two-column grid (1fr 1fr) for Duration/Place inputs never collapses to one column; at ~250px each cell is ~100px, forcing the inputs and their placeholders ('3 / 9 / 21 / 48 days', 'Home / temple / kshetra') into a cramped, unreadable two-up layout instead of stacking.
currentCode:

set("remedy_place", e.target.value)} style={inp} placeholder="Home / temple / kshetra" />
